extName.description: Имя расширения в браузере и в списке расширений.

extDescription.message: Sends the open page to Beresta for Mac as an article in your Inbox — to read and highlight like a book.

tokenNeededBody.message: Open the extension settings and paste the token from Beresta: Settings → Clippings.

pageUnreadableBody.message: The browser does not let extensions read this page.

wrongTokenBody.message: Copy the token from Beresta again (Settings → Clippings) into the extension settings.

doneBody.message: The page is waiting in the Beresta Inbox.

duplicateBody.message: This page was clipped before, so no duplicate was made.

failedBody.message: Beresta could not save this page.

optionsHint.message: Beresta shows both: Settings → Clippings. Saved as you type.

queuedBody.message: Beresta is not answering, so the page is kept here. It will be sent by itself once Beresta is open with “Accept clippings from the browser” on (Settings → Clippings).

queueFullBody.message: Beresta is not answering, and the queue is full: $COUNT$ pages are already waiting. Open Beresta so they can go, then press the button again.

queueDeliveredBody.message: Pages from the queue: $COUNT$. They are waiting in the Beresta Inbox.

reasonNotArticle.message: No article text was found on this page.

pageTooBigBody.message: This page is too large to keep while Beresta is closed. Open Beresta and press the button again.

storageFailedBody.message: The browser refused to keep the page while Beresta is closed. Open Beresta and press the button again.
